title: menispermum oblongifolium
intro: Menispermum oblongifolium, commonly known as Tinospora cordifolia in some regions, is a plant species within the Menispermaceae family, native to the Himalayan regions and parts of Asia. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Menispermum oblongifolium include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
